svg.title: Making Seedling Pots from Used Cardboard
svg.desc: A production diagram has eight main stages from cardboard collection to packing finished pots. A separate recovery tank receives water from pressing and returns it to soaking. Fresh water enters soaking when needed, and non-paper waste leaves at sorting. Full source data: {"layout":"Arrange the main sequence from left to right. Place the recovery tank below the main sequence, with labelled water arrows linking pressing to the tank and the tank to soaking.","mainsequence":["collection","sorting","shredding","soaking","moulding","pressing","drying","packing"],"stages":[{"id":"collection","label":"Collect cardboard","details":"Used cardboard is delivered to the workshop."},{"id":"sorting","label":"Sort materials","details":"Workers remove plastic tape and other non-paper materials."},{"id":"shredding","label":"Shred cardboard","details":"A machine cuts the sorted cardboard into small pieces."},{"id":"soaking","label":"Soak and mix","details":"The pieces are mixed with water for two hours to form pulp."},{"id":"moulding","label":"Fill pot moulds","details":"Wet pulp is placed in pot-shaped mesh moulds."},{"id":"pressing","label":"Press the pulp","details":"A press compresses the pulp in the moulds and extracts water."},{"id":"drying","label":"Air-dry the pots","details":"The formed pots are removed from the moulds and dried on racks for 24 hours."},{"id":"packing","label":"Stack and pack","details":"Dry pots are stacked and packed for distribution."},{"id":"water-tank","label":"Recovery tank","details":"Extracted water is collected and returned to the soaking stage."}],"flows":[{"from":"collection","to":"sorting","kind":"material","label":"Used cardboard"},{"from":"sorting","to":"shredding","kind":"material","label":"Sorted cardboard"},{"from":"shredding","to":"soaking","kind":"material","label":"Small cardboard pieces"},{"from":"soaking","to":"moulding","kind":"material","label":"Wet pulp"},{"from":"moulding","to":"pressing","kind":"material","label":"Filled moulds"},{"from":"pressing","to":"drying","kind":"material","label":"Formed pots"},{"from":"drying","to":"packing","kind":"material","label":"Dry pots"},{"from":"pressing","to":"water-tank","kind":"water","label":"Extracted water"},{"from":"water-tank","to":"soaking","kind":"water","label":"Recovered water"}],"inputs":[{"to":"soaking","label":"Fresh water when needed"}],"outputs":[{"from":"sorting","label":"Plastic tape and other non-paper waste"},{"from":"packing","label":"Packed seedling pots"}]}
